data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a positive deviation of GBP 10.9m (2013: positive deviation of GBP 5.0m); this comprises of releases GBP 8.5m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business and GBP 2.4m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net prior year reserve release of GBP 10.9 million in 2014, representing a 2.11% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favourable development was driven by releases of GBP 8.5 million from direct Third Party Liability business and GBP 2.4 million from total Reinsurance business. The Managing Agent's Report also noted "some prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes."
raw_causal_phrases: some prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes
releases GBP 8.5m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business
releases GBP 2.4m in respect of total Reinsurance business
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is stated net of reinsurance recoveries, as a gross figure was not available in the report.
